Roam

Plan your own trip.

A short guide to planning your first trip. Every picture is a real screen from the app, with circles showing where to click.

How to use Roam

Your first trip, step by step

Every trip has three tabs — Map, Plan and Agenda — and the steps below use all three. The pictures can show your phone or your computer; switch any time with these buttons.

1

Sign in

Tap Continue with Google to sign in. There's no password to remember. You'll land on the Journeys page — that's where all your trips live.

1 Tap the + to start a new trip 2 Or tap a trip to open it — the pictures that follow are the Australia trip
2

Set up your trip

Fill in the four rows, then press Plan this journey. Roam sets up the whole trip for you — one page for each day, photo included.

1 Fill the four rows — a name, where you're going, your dates, how many people — then press Plan this journey
3

Save places on the Map

A new trip starts on an empty map. That's normal — this is where you collect ideas. Type any place you're curious about into the search bar, then pick it from the list.

1 Type the place name here 2 Then tap the right one in the list

A card pops up with photos and the address. Choose what kind of place it is — Activity, Food or Logistics — then press Save to Map.

1 Pick what kind of place it is 2 Then press Save to Map

Save more than you'll use — a restaurant a friend mentioned, a museum you saw online, your hotel. Saving a place doesn't put it on your schedule. It just keeps the idea safe. Your map shows two kinds of pins:

Hollow pinjust an idea for now
Filled pinbooked into one of your days
1 Every place you've saved, as a pin 2 These buttons hide or show pins 2 Filter hides or shows pins
4

Build your days on the Plan tab

Open the Plan tab. Each day of your trip is a column. Drag a place from one day to another, or press Add from saved to pick from the places you saved on the map. Don't worry — moving things around never deletes anything.

1 The Plan tab 2 Drag a card to move it to another day 2 Swipe left or right to change days 3 Add from saved shows your saved places

You can also do this from the map. Click any pin, then press Add to day and pick the day.

1 Add to day puts this place into your plan
Tip: don't overfill your days. Two or three things a day is plenty. Free time is part of a good trip.
5

On the trip, use the Agenda

The Agenda tab shows one day at a time: your stops in order, and a map with numbered pins that match the list. During your trip, it opens on today by itself.

1 Tap a day to jump to it 2 Tap a stop to see the details 3 The numbers match your list

Tap any stop to see everything about it — photos, opening hours, your notes, and buttons to get directions (Maps), see the Website, or Call the place.

1 Maps for directions, Call to phone the place 2 Add a start time to build your day's schedule
Worth knowing

Handy things to know

Swipe to change days

On your phone, swipe left or right to move between days. This works on the Agenda and the Plan.

Add something between stops

On the Agenda, when there's free time between two stops, a small + Add button appears between them. Tap it to add something in that gap.

Add start times

When you give your stops start times, the day sorts itself into a schedule. Roam will also warn you if a place is closed when you plan to go.

Note who recommended it

When you save a place, you can write in who told you about it. Weeks later, that note is how you'll remember why it's on your map. Forgot at the time? Tap the pin, then tap Who recommended it? and type the name.

Write a note on a pin

Tap any pin on the Map and tap Add a note. Write what you want to remember: "book for seven", "closed Fridays", "the cannoli place". If there's already a note, tap it to change it. The note shows on the pin and on the card.

Send your trip to someone

At the top of your trip there's a small circle for each person who can see it. Tap the + beside them, type an email address, and press the arrow. Roam sends them the link itself. They can look at your plan and your map, but they can't change anything.

Give each day a name

On the Plan tab, tap the day of the week at the top of a column and type what the day is: "Beach", "Florence", "Rest". It shows under the weekday, and on your phone under the day's date, so you know what's happening without reading every card.

Make your own columns

On the Plan tab, each day is a column. You can add columns of your own too — tap + Add a list and name it anything: Packing, Bookings, Maybe. What you put there doesn't belong to any one day.

Take a stop off a day without losing it

Open the card and tap the small back-arrow button next to the bin. The stop comes off that day but stays saved on your map. You get six seconds to undo. The same choice appears if you tap the bin on a pin that's already on a day.

Tick things off on a card

Open a card and tap Add a checklist. Handy for what to pack, or what still needs booking. The card shows how many you've ticked, so you can see what's left without opening it.

Mark the ones you loved

Open a card and tap the heart. Next year, that's how you'll remember which places were actually worth it — your own opinion, not a stranger's review.

Archive, don't delete

Old trips move down into "Past journeys" on their own. Archive hides a trip, and you can always bring it back. Delete is permanent.
